note: Wave 320: the Wave 319 replacement for Crankshaft, Marine Diesel is a steam turbine rotor on trestles -- bladed discs on a shaft, in a marine workshop with a diesel engine behind it. Related, and not a crankshaft: a crankshaft has offset journals and no blades. The critic scored it 7 on an Unsplash caption of 'a room with a bunch of machines inside of it', which is what a critic does when the caption describes the room and not the object. The query ladder's fault was not the ladder: 'Crankshaft, Marine Diesel' returned something, so it never fell through to 'Crankshaft'. Override forces the head noun.
